census: codex session inheritance by the rollout's own task boundary
after_window_rule: codex dispatch run-id timestamp > 2026-09-23T10:40:20Z, the committer time of adbb606797e2561dcc31758e49458f1d1bac3fef, which keyed session reuse to the run's own task

parser.resume_recovered_from: the session rollout task boundary: a run that inherits an earlier transcript appends a task to an earlier rollout, a fresh run opens one
parser.session_join: run dirs are grouped by the thread_id in the first stream record; the rollout filename carries the same session id
parser.run_to_task: each run id is matched to the unclaimed task_started whose started_at is nearest the run id timestamp (tolerance 900s), runs taken in timestamp order
parser.first_request_input: the first token_count last_token_usage.input_tokens after the run task_started
parser.cumulative_input: the sum of last_token_usage.input_tokens over the run task
parser.task_worktree: the worktree recorded in the task's own first turn_context, which names the node that opened the task without a join to any run record
parser.task_identity: the identity the session-reuse rule keys on: (project, plan, node) for an implement, test or investigate run, and the reviewed run for a review
parser.same_task_resumes: an inherited transcript whose task identity matches this run's, including a run that continues its own session
parser.cross_task_resumes: an inherited transcript whose task identity differs from this run's: the condition the reuse rule removes

argv_note: No codex run carries a resume token in its recorded argv. The dialect appends a resume clause to a codex exec argv, but argv is durably recorded only on the ephemeral live pointers, so the resume is recovered from the rollout, the only durable record of the append. A dispatch pointer's session_resumed flag is not a substitute: a pointer can carry the flag with no resume token in argv and a rollout that opened fresh.
scan_notes: The first-record histogram is the scan's own positive control: the codex dialect (3017 runs) and another dialect (3112 runs) are both present, so the scan discriminates rather than returning nothing.
negative_control_note: The after-window rows are stored whole because the population is small; the before-window comparison is stored as counts only.
